_comment: Seeded by `aios repo-bootstrap` (AIO-602): default-deny file-size gate, fresh (EMPTY) grandfather list. Every file matched by `include` (minus `exclude`) must be <= defaultCap lines (wc -l semantics) — enforced by scripts/check-file-size.mjs. A file may only enter `grandfathered` when the gate is first turned on over pre-existing debt; each value is a ratchet CEILING that only ever moves DOWN (`--ratchet` lowers it automatically) and never up. New files are never grandfathered. AIO-594 cut: `grandfathered` carries the aios-workspace size-caps.json entries (@10099cd8) whose files travelled in the extraction set — 9 of core's 62 — re-measured at cut time (ratchet ceilings only go DOWN from here). test/build-loop.test.mjs was under core's cap and crossed 500 only via the cut's toolkit-skip guard (+9 lines); grandfathered at its measured cut-time count with this note as the reason.
